'''Conduit Outlet Manifold''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A large outlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.|Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Outlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings to greatly improve fluid transport efficiency.}}
==Usage==
A large outlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.

==Acquisition==
Requirement : [[AIC Factory Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Conduit Manifolds]]
